verdict.rationale: AutoGen provides building blocks (AssistantAgent with tool use, memory, multi-agent teams, AutoGen Studio for building/testing agents) that a developer could use to construct data-analysis or insight-generating agents, but there is no evidence of a built-in, turnkey feature that ingests a user's data and surfaces AI-generated insights inside the product itself — it remains a framework requiring custom agent construction. Missing for 10: a documented out-of-the-box 'analyze my data / dashboard insights' feature, evidence of automatic data ingestion, and independent hands-on confirmation of insight quality on real datasets.
